_comment: The first farms, from the green lots in stock in October 2026. The farms page shows these until Farm documents are published in Sanity, and `npm run seed:sanity` copies them there. Empty fields are hidden on the page.

farms.name: Marlon Bolaños
farms.story: Marlon Bolaños grows the three lots we hold from Acevedo, in southern Huila: a natural Geisha, a honey-processed Pink Bourbon and a natural decaf. All three are SMS exclusives in the Coffee Lab.

farms.name: Sebas
farms.story: Sebas co-ferments cherry with blackberry in Quindío, in Colombia's coffee axis. The fruit carries straight through to the cup.

farms.name: Strawberry Jam
farms.story: A Colombian co-ferment fermented with strawberry. It is our brightest, fruitiest lot and we roast it light to keep it that way.

farms.name: Salmo
farms.story: A natural-process Brazil that gives our blends their body and a nutty, chocolate base.

farms.name: Guji
farms.story: A washed coffee from the Guji highlands of southern Ethiopia: floral and tea-like, with citrus up front.

farms.name: Veracruz
farms.story: A natural-process coffee from Veracruz, on Mexico's Gulf coast. Easygoing and sweet, it works in almost any blend.
